rationale: C24 is a direct and material drafting template for the Guam proclamation. The child expressly identifies the July 20, 1948 proclamation and reuses its statutory recitals, numbered registration scheme, age-based scheduling machinery, personal appearance requirements, delayed-registration rules, compliance command, calls for assistance, and employer-cooperation provision, adapting them principally by adding Guam and updating dates and statutory language. C10 also closely parallels several operative registration clauses but concerns a distinct special registration. C21 supplies related regulatory language, though it is less directly the proclamation-level template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The registration of male citizens of the United States, and other male persons, now or hereafter in Guam, who shall have attained the eighteenth anniversary ... and ... shall have not attained the twenty-sixth anniversary ... shall take place in Guam between the hours of 8:00 A.M. and 5:00 P.M.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The registration of male citizens of the United States and other male persons residing in the United States who shall have attained the eighteenth anniversary ... and ... shall have not attained the twenty-sixth anniversary ... shall take place in the several States ... between the hours of 8:00 A.M. and 5:00 P.M.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reuses C24's principal registration provision while substituting Guam for the earlier geographic coverage.

shared_material.child_excerpt: If ... because of circumstances beyond his control [he] is unable to present himself for and submit to registration ... he shall do so as soon as possible after the cause for such inability ceases to exist.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: If he is ... unable to present himself for and submit to registration ... because of circumstances beyond his control ... he shall do so as soon as possible after the cause for such inability ceases to exist.
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves C24's delayed-registration rule and language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Every person subject to registration is required to familiarize himself with the rules and regulations governing registration and to comply therewith.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Every person subject to registration is required to familiarize himself with the rules and regulations governing registration and to comply therewith.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I call upon the Governor of Guam, all officers and agents of Guam, and all local boards ... to do and perform all acts and services necessary to accomplish effective and complete registration.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I call upon the Governors ... and all officers and agents ... and all local boards ... to do and perform all acts and services necessary to accomplish effective and complete registration.
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C24's administrative mobilization clause specifically to Guam.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I urge all employers and Government agencies of all kinds - Federal and local - to give those under their charge sufficient time in which to fulfill the obligations of registration incumbent upon them
